posts.title: How to stop a puppy from biting
posts.description: Why puppies bite and what actually helps.
posts.body:
Puppies explore the world with their mouths. Biting is normal, but they need to learn how gentle to be.

## Redirect to a toy

When teeth touch skin, offer a chew toy instead and praise when they take it.

## Calm, not rough

Rough play winds puppies up. Short, calm sessions work better.

## Naps matter

Overtired puppies bite more. Most need 18 hours of sleep a day.

posts.title: Loose-leash walking: the basics
posts.description: Teach your dog to walk without pulling.
posts.body:
Pulling works for dogs because it gets them where they want to go. Loose-leash walking changes that.

## Stop when the leash goes tight

Stand still until there's slack, then carry on.

## Reward the right spot

Give a treat when your dog is next to your leg.

## Short sessions

Practice five minutes at a time, in a quiet place first.
